Q: Which department offers the most number of degrees? List department name and id.
R: SELECT T2.department_name ,  T1.department_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Departments AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id GROUP BY T1.department_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the name and id of the department with the most number of degrees ?
R: select t2.department_name ,  t1.department_id from degree_programs as t1 join departments as t2 on t1.department_id  =  t2.department_id group by t1.department_id order by count(*) desc limit 1

Q: How many different degree names are offered?
R: SELECT count(DISTINCT degree_summary_name) FROM Degree_Programs

Q: How many different degrees are offered?
R: SELECT count(DISTINCT degree_summary_name) FROM Degree_Programs

Q: How many degrees does the engineering department offer?
R: SELECT count(*) FROM Departments AS T1 JOIN Degree_Programs AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id WHERE T1.department_name  =  'engineer'

Q: How many degrees does the engineering department have?
R: SELECT count(*) FROM Departments AS T1 JOIN Degree_Programs AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id WHERE T1.department_name  =  'engineer'

Q: What are the names and id of courses having at most 2 sections?
R: SELECT T1.course_name ,  T1.course_id FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Sections AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id HAVING count(*)  <=  2

Q: What are the names and ids of every course with less than 2 sections?
R: SELECT T1.course_name ,  T1.course_id FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Sections AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_id HAVING count(*)  <=  2

Q: List the section_name in reversed lexicographical order.
R: SELECT section_name FROM Sections ORDER BY section_name DESC

Q: What are the names of the sections in reverse alphabetical order?
R: SELECT section_name FROM Sections ORDER BY section_name DESC

Q: What is the description of the department whose name has the substring the computer?
R: SELECT department_description FROM Departments WHERE department_name LIKE '%computer%'

Q: What is the department description for the one whose name has the word computer?

Q: Find the program which most number of students are enrolled in. List both the id and the summary.
R: SELECT T1.degree_program_id ,  T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_program_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the program id and the summary of the degree that has the most students enrolled?
R: SELECT T1.degree_program_id ,  T1.degree_summary_name FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id GROUP BY T1.degree_program_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: Which student has enrolled for the most times in any program? List the id, first name, middle name, last name, the number of enrollments and student id.
R: SELECT T1.student_id ,  T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name ,  count(*) ,  T1.student_id FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the first, middle, and last name, along with the id and number of enrollments, for the student who enrolled the most in any program?
R: SELECT T1.student_id ,  T1.first_name ,  T1.middle_name ,  T1.last_name ,  count(*) ,  T1.student_id FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: Which semesters do not have any student enrolled? List the semester name.
R: SELECT semester_name FROM Semesters WHERE semester_id NOT IN( SELECT semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment )

Q: What is the name of the semester with no students enrolled?
R: SELECT semester_name FROM Semesters WHERE semester_id NOT IN( SELECT semester_id FROM Student_Enrolment )

Q: What's the name of the course with most number of enrollments?
R: SELECT  T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: What is the name of the course with the most students enrolled?
R: SELECT  T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

Q: Find the last name of the students who currently live in the state of North Carolina but have not registered in any degree program.
R: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id

Q: What are the last name of the students who live in North Carolina but have not registered in any degree programs?
R: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id

Q: Show the date and id of the transcript with at least 2 course results.
R: SELECT T2.transcript_date ,  T1.transcript_id FROM Transcript_Contents AS T1 JOIN Transcripts AS T2 ON T1.transcript_id  =  T2.transcript_id GROUP BY T1.transcript_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

Q: Find the semester when both Master students and Bachelor students got enrolled in.
R: SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Master' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT T2.semester_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T2 ON T1.degree_program_id  =  T2.degree_program_id WHERE degree_summary_name  =  'Bachelor'

Q: What is the id of the semester that had both Masters and Bachelors students enrolled?
